ideas.title: Last long run
ideas.quote: Do your last long run. Keep it steady, not heroic.
ideas.sourceTitle: Half Marathon Taper: 2-Week Plan Before Race Day

ideas.title: Short tempo run or reduced interval session
ideas.quote: Do your last real workout, such as a short tempo run or reduced interval session.
ideas.sourceTitle: Half Marathon Taper: 2-Week Plan Before Race Day

ideas.title: Relaxed strides
ideas.quote: Add a few relaxed strides if your legs feel good.
ideas.sourceTitle: Half Marathon Taper: 2-Week Plan Before Race Day

ideas.title: Very short shakeout jog
ideas.quote: Rest or do a very short shakeout jog. Nothing that leaves fatigue behind.
ideas.sourceTitle: Half Marathon Taper: 2-Week Plan Before Race Day

ideas.title: Strides
ideas.quote: Strides (4-6 x 20-30 seconds) 2-3 times
ideas.sourceTitle: Taper Week Strategies 2026: Complete Guide to Pre-Race Tapering for Peak Performance

ideas.title: Shakeout jog
ideas.quote: Shakeout jog day before (15-20 min easy)
ideas.sourceTitle: Taper Week Strategies 2026: Complete Guide to Pre-Race Tapering for Peak Performance

ideas.title: Light stretching and mobility work
ideas.quote: Light stretching and mobility work
ideas.sourceTitle: Taper Week Strategies 2026: Complete Guide to Pre-Race Tapering for Peak Performance

ideas.title: Short strides
ideas.quote: Short strides (4x20 sec) with long rest
ideas.sourceTitle: Taper Week Strategies 2026: Complete Guide to Pre-Race Tapering for Peak Performance

ideas.title: Foam Rolling and Dynamic Stretching
ideas.quote: Spend 15 minutes on a foam roller or do some light dynamic stretching.
ideas.sourceTitle: How to Train the Week Before a Half Marathon: Taper Tips

ideas.title: Sharpening Run with Strides
ideas.quote: Run 20–30 minutes total. Include 3 or 4 "strides"—these are 20-second accelerations where you reach about 90% of your max speed.
ideas.sourceTitle: How to Train the Week Before a Half Marathon: Taper Tips

ideas.title: Easy Maintenance Run
ideas.quote: 20–30 minutes at a very relaxed, conversational pace.
ideas.sourceTitle: How to Train the Week Before a Half Marathon: Taper Tips

ideas.title: Pre-Race Shakeout
ideas.quote: A 10–15 minute shakeout run followed by 2 light strides.
ideas.sourceTitle: How to Train the Week Before a Half Marathon: Taper Tips

ideas.title: 4 x 200m speed runs
ideas.when: Tuesday of Week 11 (2 weeks before race)
ideas.quote: Sprint at 3K pace to feel the rapid leg turnover rhythm
ideas.sourceTitle: Half Marathon Taper Strategy for the Final 2 Weeks: Preserving Your Leg Speed - 運動知識｜CT Yeh 公路車基地

ideas.title: 6 x 100m strides
ideas.quote: Gradually accelerate to 90% of top speed, then decelerate naturally
ideas.sourceTitle: Half Marathon Taper Strategy for the Final 2 Weeks: Preserving Your Leg Speed - 運動知識｜CT Yeh 公路車基地

ideas.title: 3 km at goal pace
ideas.quote: Insert 2–3 km at half marathon goal pace into easy runs to confirm “your body remembers that rhythm”
ideas.sourceTitle: Half Marathon Taper Strategy for the Final 2 Weeks: Preserving Your Leg Speed - 運動知識｜CT Yeh 公路車基地

ideas.title: Light cross-training
ideas.quote: Substitute light cross-training (swimming, yoga) for the urge to run more
ideas.sourceTitle: Half Marathon Taper Strategy for the Final 2 Weeks: Preserving Your Leg Speed - 運動知識｜CT Yeh 公路車基地

ideas.title: Overhead Squats
ideas.quote: Start with 1 set x 10 reps.
ideas.sourceTitle: The Perfect Running Warm-Up: 5 Pre-Run Mobility Exercises

ideas.title: Knee Bends
ideas.quote: Start with 8-10 reps and build to 15 reps for each leg.
ideas.sourceTitle: The Perfect Running Warm-Up: 5 Pre-Run Mobility Exercises

ideas.title: Front Lunge
ideas.quote: Start with 1 set x 3-5 reps if lunges aren't part of your regular routine.
ideas.sourceTitle: The Perfect Running Warm-Up: 5 Pre-Run Mobility Exercises

ideas.title: Side Lunge
ideas.quote: If you haven't been doing side lunges, start with 1 set x 3-5 reps.
ideas.sourceTitle: The Perfect Running Warm-Up: 5 Pre-Run Mobility Exercises

ideas.title: Pre-Race Easy Jog
ideas.quote: Begin with a very easy jog for 10 minutes to raise core temperature without tiring yourself out.
ideas.sourceTitle: The Importance of the Pre-Race Warm-Up: A Routine to Activate the Body and Calm the Mind

ideas.title: Dynamic Mobility and Drills
ideas.quote: Follow with 5 minutes of dynamic mobility and drills to “wake up” joints and tendons specifically.
ideas.sourceTitle: The Importance of the Pre-Race Warm-Up: A Routine to Activate the Body and Calm the Mind

ideas.title: Race Pace Strides
ideas.quote: Finish with 3–5 minutes of strides at race pace to “trick” your nervous system into readiness.
ideas.sourceTitle: The Importance of the Pre-Race Warm-Up: A Routine to Activate the Body and Calm the Mind

ideas.title: Dynamic leg swings
ideas.quote: 10 to 15 front-to-back swings and 10 to 15 side-to-side swings per leg.
ideas.sourceTitle: The Best Mobility Drills for Runners Who Want Fewer Injuries - Fitness Warrior Nation

ideas.title: Ankle circles
ideas.when: before runs if your calves and ankles feel stiff
ideas.quote: 10 to 15 controlled circles each direction per ankle.
ideas.sourceTitle: The Best Mobility Drills for Runners Who Want Fewer Injuries - Fitness Warrior Nation

ideas.title: Hip flexor stretch
ideas.when: after a run or on recovery days
ideas.quote: 20 to 30 seconds per side after a run or on recovery days.
ideas.sourceTitle: The Best Mobility Drills for Runners Who Want Fewer Injuries - Fitness Warrior Nation

ideas.title: Cat-cow
ideas.when: after long sitting and hard training
ideas.quote: 8 to 12 slow cycles.
ideas.sourceTitle: The Best Mobility Drills for Runners Who Want Fewer Injuries - Fitness Warrior Nation

ideas.title: 10-Minute Mobility Routine
ideas.when: Before running or on rest days
ideas.quote: Try this practical 10-minute mobility routine for runners to loosen stiff hips and ankles.
ideas.sourceTitle: Mobility Exercises for Runners: 10-Minute Routine

ideas.title: Wall Ankle Rocks
ideas.quote: Stiff ankles or heels lifting during squats: Start With Wall ankle rocks.
ideas.sourceTitle: Mobility Exercises for Runners: 10-Minute Routine

ideas.title: Standing Hip Circles and 90/90 Hip Switches
ideas.when: Before running or during a separate session
ideas.quote: Hips feel stiff after sitting: Start With Standing hip circles and 90/90 hip switches.
ideas.sourceTitle: Mobility Exercises for Runners: 10-Minute Routine

ideas.title: Couch Stretch
ideas.when: After running or on rest days
ideas.quote: Tightness through the front of the hip: Start With Couch stretch.
ideas.sourceTitle: Mobility Exercises for Runners: 10-Minute Routine

ideas.title: Test new shoes on a long run
ideas.when: on one of your long-ish runs
ideas.quote: Test them out early, on one of your long-ish runs, to make sure they indeed will work for you.
ideas.sourceTitle: r/Marathon_Training on Reddit: How soon should I break in my new running shoes before a marathon?

ideas.title: Short test runs for new shoes
ideas.quote: Try them on a few short runs and then on one of your final long runs just to make sure they don’t start hurting in like hour 2.5.
ideas.sourceTitle: r/Marathon_Training on Reddit: How soon should I break in my new running shoes before a marathon?

ideas.title: Taper run in new shoes
ideas.quote: I’d wear them during your taper to make sure they don’t hurt your feet
ideas.sourceTitle: r/Marathon_Training on Reddit: How soon should I break in my new running shoes before a marathon?

ideas.title: Long run in race shoes
ideas.when: on one of your final long runs
ideas.quote: I give them at least one long run or approx ~2.5 - 3 hours.
ideas.sourceTitle: r/Marathon_Training on Reddit: How soon should I break in my new running shoes before a marathon?

ideas.title: Long runs in new race shoes
ideas.quote: Buy new race shoes 4–6 weeks before race day and use them for all your long runs to accumulate break-in miles safely.
ideas.sourceTitle: How Long to Break In Running Shoes? Miles, Not Days

ideas.title: Shoe rotation for foam recovery
ideas.quote: Alternating between two pairs during break-in gives each shoe time to recover between sessions.
ideas.sourceTitle: How Long to Break In Running Shoes? Miles, Not Days

ideas.title: Blister prevention routine
ideas.quote: Synthetic or merino wool socks, anti-chafing balm, and 24–48 hour recovery between runs cut blister risk significantly during break-in.
ideas.sourceTitle: How Long to Break In Running Shoes? Miles, Not Days

ideas.title: Wear new shoes around the house
ideas.when: When you first get your new shoes
ideas.quote: Wear them around the house for at least three hours a day.
ideas.sourceTitle: How to Break in New Running Shoes: Easy Tips for a Comfy Fit

ideas.title: Short walks in new shoes
ideas.when: Once your shoes feel comfortable at home
ideas.quote: These 10-15 minute walks help your feet adjust gradually.
ideas.sourceTitle: How to Break in New Running Shoes: Easy Tips for a Comfy Fit

ideas.title: Shorter runs at half distance
ideas.when: After a few days of short walks
ideas.quote: After a few days, progress to shorter runs and cover about half your usual distance.
ideas.sourceTitle: How to Break in New Running Shoes: Easy Tips for a Comfy Fit

ideas.title: Alternate old and new shoes
ideas.quote: Switch things up by alternating between your old shoes and your new running shoes.
ideas.sourceTitle: How to Break in New Running Shoes: Easy Tips for a Comfy Fit
